title: Employee Leave Policy
text: # TechNova Solutions - Employee Leave Policy Document ID: DOC001 ## Purpose The Employee Leave Policy explains the types of leave available to employees at TechNova Solutions and the basic process for requesting leave. ## Annual Leave Employees can request annual leave for personal requirements, planned vacations, or other approved purposes. Employees should submit their leave request in advance whenever possible. ## Sick Leave Employees may use sick leave when they are unable to work because of illness. For an extended absence, the employee may be asked to provide appropriate supporting documentation according to company procedures. ## Emergency Leave

text: Employees may use sick leave when they are unable to work because of illness. The request should include the requested dates and the type of leave.

title: Employee Leave Policy
text: Employees should submit leave requests through the approved internal leave system. The request should include the requested dates and the type of leave.
